settings.text: Soft, thoughtful clothing for little ones, made with love by Mia & Co.

settings.heading: Made for the little moments
settings.text:
Cuddles began with a simple wish: clothes that feel as gentle as a hug. Every piece is designed for comfort first, in breathable, skin-friendly fabrics that move with growing children through naps, play and everything in between.

We make in small batches with local makers across India, paying close attention to every seam, smocked panel and tiny bow. Nothing is rushed, and nothing is made in excess.

settings.heading: Gentle fabrics
settings.content: Soft, breathable cotton and muslin chosen to be kind to delicate skin.

settings.heading: Made in small batches
settings.content: Crafted with local makers in India, so every piece gets the care it deserves.

settings.heading: Designed to be loved
settings.content: Timeless styles made to be worn, washed and handed down.
